ENGINE_TRANSIENT.description: Fast load steps with brief transient spikes; correlated O2/CO2/NOx/CH4/VOC trends. Good for engines and control demos.
notes: NOx increases with load; CH4/VOC spike during transients

BOILER_STEADY.description: Slow ramps with tight noise; stable combustion trends. Good for boilers/heaters and steady-state QA/QC.

FLARE_SPIKY.description: Low baseline with intermittent spikes to mimic flare events or unstable venting.
notes: Spikes drive NOx/CO2 bursts and CH4/VOC disturbances

CAL_CYCLE.description: Structured zero/span plateaus bracketing a transient test window; useful for QA/QC and training.
